# Not for You

> A free browser extension that removes algorithmic feeds from every major
> social platform: YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X/Twitter, Reddit, LinkedIn,
> Threads and Facebook. It swaps each platform's recommendation feed for the
> chronological feed of accounts the user actually follows. No suggested
> posts, no recommended accounts, no "For You."

Key facts:

- Works in Firefox, and in Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Arc and other Chromium
  browsers.
- Installed from Firefox Add-ons
  (https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/notforyou/). The Chrome Web Store
  listing is in review.
- Every change is a per-platform checkbox in the popup, so any of it can be
  turned off. A pause button brings the algorithm back for a few minutes.
- Per platform: YouTube shows Subscriptions instead of Home (with options to
  turn off autoplay and hide Shorts), Instagram, TikTok, X/Twitter and
  Threads show the Following feed instead of For You, LinkedIn sorts by
  Recent instead of Top, Facebook opens the Feeds view, and Reddit gets
  promoted posts and recommendations hidden.
- Nothing else changes: search, profiles, messages and posting work as
  before. It is not a feed blocker; the feed stays, just chronological.
- Collects no data and sends nothing anywhere. Settings live in the
  browser's own storage.
- Free and open source (MIT).

## Pages

- [Home](https://notforyou.app/): what the extension changes on each
  platform, and a FAQ.
- [YouTube without the algorithm](https://notforyou.app/youtube): opening
  Subscriptions instead of Home, hiding Shorts, turning off autoplay.
- [Instagram without the algorithm](https://notforyou.app/instagram): the
  Following feed every time, no suggested posts or accounts.
- [TikTok without the algorithm](https://notforyou.app/tiktok): the
  Following feed instead of the For You page.
- [X/Twitter without the algorithm](https://notforyou.app/twitter): keeping
  the chronological Following feed, hiding trends and suggestions.
- [Reddit without the clutter](https://notforyou.app/reddit): hiding
  promoted posts, ads and subreddit recommendations; old Reddit optional.
- [LinkedIn without the algorithm](https://notforyou.app/linkedin): sorted
  by Recent, without suggested posts or the news sidebar.
- [Threads without the algorithm](https://notforyou.app/threads): the
  Following feed, newest first, every visit.
- [Facebook without the algorithm](https://notforyou.app/facebook): the
  chronological Feeds view instead of Home, without the Reels tab.
- [Privacy policy](https://notforyou.app/privacy): no data collection, in
  full.
